Hi Alex — great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kicks off:

- Summary of ask: real-time summarization and semantic search over ingest of ~200M tokens/month; target 99th p50 latency ~300ms for short prompts, occasional long form >=2k tokens for batch jobs.
- Key success criteria: (1) median latency <250ms for chat burst; (2) quality parity with current baseline on 3 eval prompt sets; (3) pilot run < $15k/month net cost after credits.
- Data/permissions: you confirmed SSO + VPC peering for private deployment is desired but for the first 4-week POC you want hosted with data isolation + audit logs.
- Action items: I’ll share a tentative cost model and proposed credit top-up; Marcus will validate expected token burn with caching recommendations.

Attachments: zetatech_poc_usage.csv (sample ingest profile).

Proposed next meeting: Tue 11/24 10am PT — to review the cost model and measurement plan. Does that work?

Thanks,
Lauren
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Lauren — thanks for the note. Couple quick questions from our finance/ops side before the next call:

1) Can you show the expected cost breakdown for "200M tokens/month" in terms of $ / 1M tokens across the model variants you recommended? Our CFO is asking for a target bucket (e.g., $X-$Y per 1M).
2) On credits: what’s the max one-time credit you can approve for a 4-week proof-of-concept if we hit the projected burn? We need visibility on downside if we spike.
3) Also, is there any automatic throttling or budget guardrail you can enable during the trial? We don’t want runaway bills.

Happy to discuss on Tue but wanted these on paper first.

-Alex

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@zetatech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Token economics sync + credit decision for ZetaTech POC

Alex — answers inline and initial proposal below. I’ve attached a lightweight cost sheet and the trial terms PDF (redwood_trial_terms.pdf).

1) Cost bands ($ / 1M tokens) — conservative breakdown for your workload (mixed chat + embedding):
   - base large open model (e.g., open-llama-13B variant): $9 / 1M tokens
   - quantized optimized variant (recommended for hosting): $6.50 / 1M tokens
   - high-throughput prod variant (dedicated + KV cache hit rate): $4.25 / 1M tokens (assumes 30% prefix cache hit and batching)

   With 200M tokens/month that maps to (list price * estimate):
   - $1,800 @ $9/1M
   - $1,300 @ $6.50/1M
   - $850 @ $4.25/1M (target with caching + batching)

   Note: these are per-month inference token costs. We recommend modeling additional margin for long-runner retraining calls and evals (~10-15%).

2) Credits: Monica — can you confirm max one-time trial credit? Marcus and I flagged potential risk if live ingestion spikes above forecast.

3) Guardrails: yes — we can provision a trial budget cap and circuit-breaker. Options:
   - Hard budget cap: stop issuing tokens at $X/month.
   - Rate limiter per API key: QPS cap to smooth spikes.
   - Auto-notify + soft throttle: warn at 60/80/95% of credit and then apply soft throttling.

If you’re comfortable with the $4.25/1M target, I can propose a credit that brings your first-month net cost under $15k (your stated target).

Marcus — can you validate whether achieved cache hit / batching assumptions are realistic for their 200M token distribution? Karthik — can you confirm SSO/VPC timeline if we need private staging?

Thanks,
Lauren

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Porter <aporter@zetatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Token economics sync + credit decision for ZetaTech POC

Alex / team — quick tech confirmation on the cost assumptions and how we get to $4.25/1M in practice:

- Cache assumptions: 30% prefix/KV cache hit is conservative for conversational workloads with repeated prompts; if your use is more query-unique we should model 10-15% instead. I used 30% because the sample (zetatech_poc_usage.csv) shows recurring patterns in the first 3 buckets.
- Batching: during overnight bulk summarization we expect higher batching efficiency (~2.8x tokens-per-op), daytime interactive traffic will be lower.
- Quantization: moving to an int4 path reduces memory + GPU cost, but may raise regen rate slightly; we’ll run evals to validate quality.

Recommendation: start the POC on quantized optimized variant with the following runtime config:
- continuous batching enabled (latency SLOs maintained)
- KV cache with 24-48h retention for session prefixes
- soft throttle at 85% of trial credit; hard cutoff at 100%

I’ll instrument a short script to emit projected burn curves for the first 4 weeks given different cache hit scenarios; I’ll upload to the Drive link before Tue.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the details. Approved credit + trial extension: we will provide a one-time $12,000 credit applied to the first invoice and extend the hosted POC window to 6 weeks (instead of 4) so you have extra runway for evals. Conditions:

- Soft throttle notifications at 60/80/95% of the $12k credit and automatic soft throttle at 85%.
- Hard cutoff at 100% of the credit unless an exception is approved by Monica.
- You must sign the trial terms (redwood_trial_terms.pdf) and confirm the test dataset and eval prompt set in Drive before we enable private peering.

Alex — please reply to confirm you accept these terms and I’ll ask Sales Ops to provision the credit and set the trial guardrails.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
